import openpyxl

# Create a new workbook
wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "General Fund Donations"

# Headers
headers = ["Transaction ID", "Donor Name", "Amount", "Date", "Notes", "Type"]
ws.append(headers)

# Venmo donation from VT-010 (jane.legal)
donations = [
    ["VT-010", "jane.legal", 200.00, "2026-10-29", "Donation to general fund on behalf of a survivor — please do not list my name publicly", "Venmo"],
]

# Write donations
for row in donations:
    ws.append(row)

# Save the workbook
wb.save('/workspace/reports/general-fund-donors-board.xlsx')
print("Spreadsheet created successfully!")
print(f"Saved to: /workspace/reports/general-fund-donors-board.xlsx")
